'''Inochi-Daimyōjin-no-Mikoto''' (命大命神命) is a deity of [[Inochi-no-Michikyō]] (命道教)

It distinctly uses the character 命 three times for three different readings [https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/%e5%91%bd#Etymology_1 Inochi] [https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/%e5%91%bd#Etymology_2 mikoto] [https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/%e5%91%bd#Etymology_4 myo] (note that etymology 4 is not quite the right one but the right one is lacking and etymology 2 and 3 are pretty similar
